messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High error rate detected on /v1/generate for region-us-west1. 5xx spike > 20% over 2m. Paging oncall: @alex :rotating_light:
alex: Just saw the page, jumping in. Any context on rollout? :eyes:
oncall-bot: oncall handover: alex has ownership for 1719978123 -> next handover at 08:00 UTC.
samir: I can help with infra traces — forwarding flamegraphs and recent deploys.
alex: Thanks @samir. Initial check: CPU on the serving pool is normal, but p50 latency doubled and we see a lot of LRU cache misses. Logs show repeated KV cache evictions. Pasting relevant tail:```stderr
2024-06-21T15:02:13Z ERROR cache: evict key=model-enc-xyz
2024-06-21T15:02:13Z WARN kernel: fallback to slower matmul
2024-06-21T15:02:14Z ERROR request: 5xx upstream timeout
```
maria: Are customers complaining? Any major tenants affected?
alex: Support reported 3 users on enterprise dedicated experiencing timeouts (reported by @kelly). Not yet a wide outage but definitely degradation for several heavy requesters.
kelly: Confirmed — customer ACME reported model responses timing out ~2min. They were on Dedicated-resv-42. Logged CS ticket #CS-9241.
liaison-bot: Alert: linked CS ticket created: CS-9241 -> Incident 1719978123
jia: On the runtime side I see a hot shard on GPU node gpu-23-az1 that's running at 98% memory and spilling. Might be top-K tokenizer cache thrash causing KV growth.
luis: I can try routing heavy tenants to standby nodes to reduce pressure. Propose emergency reroute for Dedicated-resv-42 to fallback-variant quantized-8bit for the next 15m. That reduces memory footprint.
alex: Go for it @luis. Please announce to customer if we initiate fallback.
luis: Starting ephemeral route: `routectl set route tenant=Dedicated-resv-42 variant=quantized-8bit priority=emergency`
ops-bot: deploy started: routing-change by luis at 2024-06-21T15:08:09Z (id: routectl-5501)
luis: Routing change completed. Verified lower memory on gpu-23-az1 and p95 latency improving for that tenant.
samir: I'm pulling KV cache metrics across the cluster. There is a global spike in eviction rate starting at 15:00 UTC. Hypothesis: a recent model rollout (v2.14) changed key prefixing which increased KV churn.
ajex: typo — alex: I mean jia — @jia did we deploy v2.14 last night?
jia: Yes, v2.14 landed in staging and was promoted at 02:30 UTC to canary then to prod at 04:10 UTC. Canary config had different cache key entropy inadvertently enabled. Rolling back that change should stop churn.
alex: Agree rollback candidate. What's risk of rollback? Any compatibility concerns?
jia: Low risk for production routes in the short term — it's a config toggle: `cache.key_entropy=false`. Rolling back will preserve model weights.
maria: From product side, this looks like P2 (degradation impacting several paying customers). We need to schedule a post-incident review and create action items.
kelly: CS wants customer-facing note. Can we provide ETA for full remediation? Right now routing fallback is mitigating but not fixed.
alex: Immediate plan: 1) keep emergency routing for affected tenants, 2) toggle cache.key_entropy=false in prod canary and monitor for 10m, 3) if green, promote change cluster-wide. Samir/Jia to own. Luis to keep routing in place until we confirm. Kelly to send interim customer update.
samir: Starting rollback toggle in canary now: `kubectl patch cm runtime-config -p '{"data":{"cache.key_entropy":"false"}}'`
ops-bot: config-change applied on canary at 2024-06-21T15:20:11Z (id: cfg-7712)
jia: Monitoring metrics -> eviction rate dropping in canary after ~2m. If stable for 10m, I'll promote to prod.
luis: Noted — keeping routing live until we see p95 < baseline for 20m.
kelly: Customer update sent: "We're aware of timeouts, mitigation in place by routing to fallback variant. Engineers are rolling back a recent caching change. We'll follow up with a postmortem and remediation timeline."
30m later...
incident-bot: RESOLVED: error rate on /v1/generate returned to baseline at 15:52 UTC. Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring.
alex: Thanks everyone. Good cross-team work. I'll schedule the PIR (post-incident review). Propose tomorrow 10:00 UTC.
maria: Adding product and support to PIR invite. We should cover customer impact, RCA, and action item sizing.
samir: RCA draft: root cause = cache key entropy change in v2.14 causing excessive KV churn and memory spills on some GPU nodes; contributing factors = canary config mismatch and no automated cache eviction alarms threshold.
jia: I'll attach the rollback diff and metrics.
luis: Proposed action items in thread — please react with :+1: if you accept and add estimates as comments.
alex: Action item A1: Add automated eviction-rate alarm (severity-based): trigger if eviction rate > 10% for 5m. Owner: samir. Estimate: 2d dev + 1d testing. Priority: P1 (S1-P1).
alex: Action item A2: Improve canary parity checks to include cache prefix validation before promotion. Owner: jia. Estimate: 3d. Priority: P1.
alex: Action item A3: Enhance routing playbook to include automatic temporary fallback when memory spills detected for a tenant. Owner: luis. Estimate: 5d. Priority: P2.
maria: Action item A4: Customer communication template and SLA review for Dedicated customers. Owner: kelly + maria. Estimate: 2d. Priority: P2. Tie into Q3 customer reliability OKR.
samir: I'll create the GH issues and link to incident. Also recommend we add an integration test that simulates high KV churn for the next cycle. Estimate: 3d. Priority: P1.
jia: Note: A2 may require infra changes for config validation. I've added +2d contingency in my calendar.
luis: For A3, we also need runbook entries and a small API to trigger routing safely. I'll scope the API as 3d. Total A3 now 8d.
alex: Let's size and prioritize into this quarter. P1s (A1, A2, GH test) should go into sprint next week. P2s (A3, A4) to plan into next-quarter planning unless we can shave scope.
maria: I'll surface P1s in tomorrow's PM sync and request capacity. Please add your GH issue numbers to the PIR doc.
kelly: I'll follow up with ACME contact after PIR with more detail and expected timelines.
alex: Scheduling PIR invite sent for 2024-06-22 10:00 UTC. Postmortem doc skeleton: https://redwood-internal/docs/incidents/1719978123
samir: Created GitHub issues: #RWI-512 (A1), #RWI-513 (A2), #RWI-514 (test). Linking in doc.
jia: I'll attach metric graphs and the rollback patch to the doc before the PIR.
luis: Adding routing runbook PR: https://git.redwood/routing/pr/88
kelly: Closing loop: CS-9241 updated with mitigation and PIR link.
alex: Closing notes: Good triage and mitigation. Action: everyone add final estimates to their GH issues by EOD. We'll review during PIR and assign sprint owners. :white_check_mark:
